# Josupeit.Practices.Schedulers.Abstractions

> Interface-only NuGet package defining `IScheduler`, the contract for handing work to an execution strategy without knowing what it is: 56 overloads in four families - `Schedule` (blocks until the item has run), `ScheduleAsync` (returns a task that completes when it has run), and `UnsafeSchedule`/`UnsafeScheduleAsync` (the same without capturing the caller's execution context) - each taking synchronous or asynchronous, cancellable or non-cancellable actions and functions, with and without a caller-supplied `CancellationToken`. Also defines `ExecutionDeclinedException`, raised when an accepted item is not executed because the scheduler stopped in the meantime. Targets netstandard2.0 and net8.0 and lives in the `Josupeit.Practices.Schedulers` namespace.

Install with `dotnet add package Josupeit.Practices.Schedulers.Abstractions`. All types live in the `Josupeit.Practices.Schedulers` namespace - not `Josupeit.Practices.Schedulers.Abstractions`. Two types:

- `IScheduler` - 12 `Schedule`, 16 `ScheduleAsync`, 12 `UnsafeSchedule`, 16 `UnsafeScheduleAsync` overloads over eight delegate shapes: `Action`, `Action<CancellationToken>`, `Func<Task>`, `Func<CancellationToken, Task>`, `Func<TResult>`, `Func<CancellationToken, TResult>`, `Func<Task<TResult>>`, `Func<CancellationToken, Task<TResult>>`
- `ExecutionDeclinedException` - `InvalidOperationException` subclass with a fixed message and constructors `()` and `(Exception innerException)`

`Schedule` blocks until the item has completed and returns a function's result directly, unwrapping `Task<TResult>`; `ScheduleAsync` returns `Task`/`Task<TResult>`. The asynchronous families take a caller `CancellationToken` for every shape; the synchronous families only for cancellable delegates - `Schedule(Action, CancellationToken)` does not exist. A cancellable delegate receives the scheduler's token, canceled on stop and when the caller's token is canceled. Token-less overloads are by contract equivalent to passing `CancellationToken.None`. `Unsafe*` members do not capture the caller's `ExecutionContext`. `IScheduler` has no lifecycle members and promises no ordering or concurrency; implementations decide. Base classes that implement all 56 members over one override ship in `Josupeit.Practices.Schedulers.Core`.

- [Complete reference](https://codeberg.org/DerPeit/Josupeit.Practices/raw/branch/main/src/Josupeit.Practices.Schedulers.Abstractions/llms-full.txt): all 56 signatures grouped by family and as a matrix, the two-token model, contract expectations and what is left open, usage, and common mistakes. Load this to write code against the package.
- [PublicAPI.Shipped.txt](https://codeberg.org/DerPeit/Josupeit.Practices/raw/branch/main/src/Josupeit.Practices.Schedulers.Abstractions/PublicAPI.Shipped.txt): analyzer-enforced inventory of every public member. `!` marks non-nullable and `?` nullable reference types; accessibility is not shown.
- [README](https://codeberg.org/DerPeit/Josupeit.Practices/raw/branch/main/src/Josupeit.Practices.Schedulers.Abstractions/README.md): human-oriented package overview as shown on NuGet.

## Related packages

- [Josupeit.Practices.Schedulers.Core](https://codeberg.org/DerPeit/Josupeit.Practices/raw/branch/main/src/Josupeit.Practices.Schedulers/llms-full.txt): base classes implementing all 56 members over a single `Enqueue`/`EnqueueAsync` override.
- [Josupeit.Practices.Schedulers.TaskPool](https://codeberg.org/DerPeit/Josupeit.Practices/raw/branch/main/src/Josupeit.Practices.Schedulers.TaskPool/llms-full.txt): immediate thread-pool dispatch, no lifecycle.
- [Josupeit.Practices.Schedulers.Channel](https://codeberg.org/DerPeit/Josupeit.Practices/raw/branch/main/src/Josupeit.Practices.Schedulers.Channel/llms-full.txt): FIFO queue with configurable parallelism and pause support.
- [Josupeit.Practices.Services.Abstractions](https://codeberg.org/DerPeit/Josupeit.Practices/raw/branch/main/src/Josupeit.Practices.Services.Abstractions/llms-full.txt): the lifecycle contracts stoppable schedulers expose; not a dependency of this package.
